waived.reason: Follow-up on the same report ('God Hand really was bad: smaller projectiles, slower attacks; Light's Anguish is certainly better'). A hit is two rectangles overlapping, so landing now widens the target by the projectile's own width (drift and spread) and height (arc, reach): Light's Anguish's 36 px dagger vs the God Hand's 10 px bolt were being graded as the same shot. Unread sizes add nothing. 1650 weapons up, 30 down (median 1.05); Freedom Star 1049 -> 312 is the carrier rule: its spawns now land enough that the holdout's assumed hit is dropped. Net calamity top-3 +4 MRR 0.235 -> 0.241, vanilla top-3/top-8/recall +2, against ieor top-8 -3 and melee recall/section hits in all three guides. Kept on the geometry, which is a fact of Projectile.Colliding, not a knob.
